studies.title: 直墙挂旗与铁链
studies.detail: Study A: two weathered deep blue narrow banners hang FLAT against intact wall panels between existing posts, each on short metal hooks fixed into the same wall face. An iron chain sags parallel to the wall between adjacent posts, never across the road. Show snow-covered hook brackets, layered cloth folds, discreet faded snowflake embroidery, icy rivets and worn bronze fittings. A tiny storm lantern hangs on a small wall hook, restrained amber glow. Sparse dead stems and a few pebbles at the foot. Structural masonry remains unbroken and perfectly collinear. Focus on wall-attached set dressing that can be isolated later.

studies.title: 直墙积雪与路面磨损
studies.detail: Study C: environment storytelling through restrained snow and weathering only. The intact wall has patches of wind-packed snow resting on its existing top, short icicles descending the inner face, carved shallow ornament and subtle seep frost. At its base show three separated shallow snow drifts, a few loose SMALL cobbles, a tiny flush metal drainage grate set into the flat ground parallel to the wall, weathered repairs of old mortar in paving and two faint overlapping cart tracks along the road. All paving stays flat and traversable. No giant cracks, fallen slabs, sinkholes, projecting supports or new stairs. The most important visual is solid convincing masonry volume with clean baseline contact.

studies.title: 直墙补给与暖光
studies.detail: Study D: a small sheltered rest/supply dressing against the same straight wall, without building any shelter. Two low weathered wooden crates, one squat rope-bound barrel, a compact folded blue tarp, one coil of rope and a small warm metal lantern sitting atop a crate, arranged as TWO modest clusters snugly in the narrow shoulder along the intact wall. Tangible top and side faces, worn wood grain, snow caps, iron hoops, realistic contact shadows on paving, restrained local warm light. Keep their silhouettes below wall top and minimize footprint, do not block the road. No bench, stall, roof, market stand, fencing, alcove, new monument, staircase or transverse masonry.
